application.name: Jira Clone
application.versionNote: the manifest version as found; the repository's own release line at this date is v2.x
application.description: A simplified Jira clone: drag-and-drop kanban board, issue detail with rich-text description and threaded comments, cross-project search, project settings
application.licenseFieldInManifest: absent — the grant is the root LICENSE file
application.backend: none — static single-page application; seed data at src/assets/data/{project,auth}.json is fetched same-origin and all mutations are in-memory Akita state that does not survive a reload

source.pinNote: Never pin the v2.0.0 tag: its tree carries no LICENSE. This commit — subject "feat: add LICENSE file after accidentally removed" — is four days later and restores it.

gitLargeFileStorage.note: Checked before trusting any asset, on the factoriolab lane's lesson. The tree is self-contained: no LFS routing, no pointer stubs, nothing to materialise.

toolchain.customWebpackConfig: ./webpack.config.js — one postcss-loader rule routing .scss through postcss-import, tailwindcss and autoprefixer
toolchain.packageManager: npm, package-lock.json lockfileVersion 2 (2747 entries, all integrity-hashed, all on registry.npmjs.org)

legacyCell.source: .nvmrc pins the major ("16"); the patch level is this ingest's choice and the runtime digest was verified against nodejs.org SHASUMS256.txt
legacyCell.label: repository-pinned as to major, era-consistent as to patch

productionBuildAsAcquired.reason: builder schema validation: angular.json's production configuration sets "extractCss", removed from the Angular 13 browser builder schema

productionBuildWithOneKeyRemoved.labeled: deviation — extractCss deleted from angular.json in the git-ignored working tree only

knownHazardsForLaterUnits: A production-configured build needs the extractCss key dropped; the repository's own build script builds unmodified but applies neither the environment.prod.ts replacement nor the src/index.prod.html index.

The application initialises Sentry (hard-coded DSN in src/main.ts) and Google Analytics (hard-coded id in core/services/google-analytics.service.ts) at bootstrap. Serving it unmodified reports to the upstream author's properties.
No state persists: every journey restarts from src/assets/data/project.json on reload.
nonclaims: This manifest records an acquired identity and one baseline attempt. It establishes no browser behavior, migration feasibility, pilot status, production readiness, certification, or legal approval.
